title: Total Solution Digital Agency
shortDescription: A premium, dark-themed digital agency website built with PHP and Bootstrap 5 — featuring a deep indigo gradient aesthetic, glassmorphism cards, AOS animations, WhatsApp integration, and localized Indian Rupee pricing for four core digital services.
overview: Total Solution is a high-end digital agency website crafted for the Indian digital services market. The platform showcases four core digital services — Website Design & Development, SEO & Digital Marketing, E-Commerce Solutions, and Website Management — in a visually immersive dark/indigo gradient aesthetic. Built with PHP 8 for server-side rendering and Bootstrap 5 for the responsive grid, the site features glassmorphism card components, animated GIF service icons, AOS (Animate on Scroll) reveal animations, Swiper.js carousel for testimonials, and direct WhatsApp integration for instant client contact. The design is fully localized for India — with Indian Rupee (₹) budget options, an Indian team showcase, and a Noida-based business context.
features: Four core digital service pages — Web Design, SEO, E-Commerce, Website Management
Deep indigo gradient hero section (#060c1f to #091128)
Glassmorphism card components with frosted glass effects
Animated GIF service icons for visual richness
AOS (Animate on Scroll) fade-in and slide animations
Direct WhatsApp integration via wa.me links for instant client contact
Portfolio gallery with case studies and project showcase
Contact page with Indian Rupee (₹) budget selection
Shared PHP header.php and footer.php includes for consistent layout
Dedicated service detail pages for each of the four services
Fully responsive — desktop, tablet, and mobile with Bootstrap 5 grid
Performance-optimized with clean, semantic code structure
SEO-ready with proper meta tags and heading structure

architecture.pattern: PHP Multi-Page with Shared Template Includes
architecture.description: Multi-page PHP website with a reusable includes system for navigation and footer. Each page is a standalone PHP file that includes header.php and footer.php for consistent layout. Dedicated sub-pages exist for each of the four core services.
pages: index.php — Homepage with hero, services overview, and testimonials
about.php — Agency story, mission, and team members
portfolio.php — Case studies and project gallery
contact.php — Contact form with ₹ budget selection and WhatsApp link
services/ — Dedicated detail pages for each service

myRole: Sole Developer and Designer. Designed and built the complete agency website from scratch — including the design system, glassmorphism UI components, PHP template architecture, responsive layout, and all service page content.
challenges: Creating a deep, immersive dark gradient aesthetic that feels premium and high-end while maintaining readability and contrast accessibility standards
Integrating animated GIF icons with CSS hover effects without causing performance issues or layout jank
Building a service-focused architecture where each of the four core services has its own dedicated detail page while maintaining shared navigation context
Localizing the contact form for Indian clients — implementing ₹ budget ranges and WhatsApp as the primary contact channel
Achieving a glassmorphism card effect that works consistently across Bootstrap's grid system without conflicting with Bootstrap's own styling
solutions: Used deeply layered CSS custom properties for the gradient system, with background: linear-gradient(135deg, #060c1f, #091128) on the base layer and radial gradient overlays for depth, ensuring all text meets WCAG contrast requirements
Optimized animated GIFs for web delivery and controlled animation timing with CSS animation-play-state to only animate on hover, reducing idle CPU usage
Created a services/ subdirectory with individual PHP files per service, each linked from the main nav and services overview section, with shared header/footer includes for consistency
Implemented a budget dropdown with predefined ₹ ranges (₹10K–₹50K, ₹50K–₹1L, ₹1L+) and added a prominent WhatsApp CTA button that opens wa.me with a pre-filled message
Applied Bootstrap utility classes for grid and spacing, then overrode with custom CSS namespaced under .glass-card to implement backdrop-filter blur without affecting Bootstrap components
keyLearnings: PHP shared include architecture for consistent multi-page website layout and navigation
Building a premium dark gradient design system that scales across multiple service pages
Bootstrap 5 customization — overriding and extending Bootstrap with custom CSS without breaking the grid system
WhatsApp Business integration for client communication in Indian market websites
AOS and Swiper.js configuration for professional scroll animations and touch-friendly carousels
